assessment.nobel_worthiness: A voice that is recognizable at once. Carson joins classical scholarship, lyric, verse-novel narrative, translation and visual or object-like form. Autobiography of Red and Nox are widely taken as formal inventions rather than mere mixtures of genre. The work is sustained over several decades and shows real intellectual depth in its handling of grief, desire and the inheritance of antiquity.
assessment.attribution: A single writer with a clearly individual practice. A citation could cover the renewal of lyric and narrative through dialogue with the classical tradition, and the reinvention of the book as a form. Her translations and stagings of Greek texts are part of the oeuvre but should be weighed as secondary to her own writing.
assessment.maturity: A substantial oeuvre with a consistent creative project, still productive. Her standing among readers of poetry is established. Her work has come to be seen as lasting and not as a passing trend.
uncertainties: Much of the effect depends on typography, page design and allusion, so the work is hard to judge in translation and may travel unevenly.
My knowledge of the full corpus is uneven, particularly the later and more performance-based pieces.
Whether the hybrid, scholar-poet mode is judged by the committee to fit Nobel's will and the 'ideal direction' criterion is open.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose with a strongly individual imaginative world. The Blinding trilogy and Solenoid build large metaphysical structures from the body, memory and dream. The ambition and the stylistic control are both high, and the voice is not easily mistaken for anyone else's.
assessment.attribution: One author writing in Romanian. A citation could cover the expansive fantastic and metaphysical novel in which the body and memory become cosmological material. His poetry and essays are also part of the corpus.
assessment.maturity: A long career of sustained and escalating ambition. The major novels are demanding and rewarding, and his reputation has grown across languages.
uncertainties: The density and Romanian wordplay of the prose make translation a serious risk, and I cannot judge the original.
His poetry and early work are less accessible to me than the major novels.
Length and excess may be read as either a strength or a weakness.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A poetry of great scale and moral weight. Purgatory and Anteparadise turn suffering and political catastrophe into collective, memorial language, and his landscape-scale and sky-writing interventions extend the poem beyond the page. The voice is unmistakable and the project is unified.
assessment.attribution: A single poet writing in Spanish. A citation could cover poetry that transforms historical violence, especially that of the Chilean dictatorship, into a shared memorial form, together with his experiments in public space.
assessment.maturity: Close to five decades of work with coherence and development. His standing in Spanish-language poetry is well established.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation loses much of its effect, and the large-scale visual works are known to me mostly through description.
The political and historical weight of the work should not stand in for the quality of the language, and I would want to test it against the Spanish text.
I know the later volumes less well than the early ones.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative, morally serious prose with a clear and individual voice. Housekeeping and the Gilead novels give theology, family and American history a precise and luminous language. The interiority and the control of tone are of a very high order.
assessment.attribution: A single writer, with fiction and essays that complement each other. A citation could cover a contemplative, theologically informed novel and its moral attention to ordinary life.
assessment.maturity: A smaller body of novels than most of the field, but with great consistency and a deepening line from Housekeeping through the Gilead sequence. The essays extend the intellectual range.
uncertainties: The number of novels is limited, and the committee may weigh breadth of oeuvre against concentration.
The religious and essayistic strand may divide opinion on its relation to Nobel's will.
The English-language prose is the original, but I have not independently verified my reading of the full essay corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque, mythic and satirical forms that expose the violence of ideology and development. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles show a willingness to take formal risks, including what the author has called mythorealism, in order to reach historical truths that conventional realism cannot. Imaginative force and moral seriousness are both evident.
assessment.attribution: One author writing in Chinese. A citation could cover the invention of a fabulist, satirical mode for dealing with the political and social history of China. Essays on his own method belong to the corpus.
assessment.maturity: A long and productive career with a consistent project. Quality seems uneven across such a large output, but the major works are strong.
uncertainties: I rely on translations, and the translators' choices strongly shape the effect of the satire and register.
Political circumstances, including censorship, must not be allowed to count as literary merit in themselves.
I am uncertain how far the fabulist method is renewed from book to book.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large polyphonic narratives that remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book have an unusual scale and a voice that is hers alone. Together they extend what the English-language novel can hold.
assessment.attribution: A single writer. A citation could cover renewing the novel through Aboriginal storytelling traditions and a vast, mythic yet political imagination. Her nonfiction is a secondary part of the oeuvre.
assessment.maturity: A relatively small number of major novels, with recent work building on the earlier ones. The question is whether the body of work has reached its full breadth.
uncertainties: The novels are long and demanding, and I cannot judge how far my reading of their language matches the author's intention.
The size of the oeuvre is modest compared with others on the list.
I may be underestimating the full corpus, including the more recent works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that turns obscure lives and art history into powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven show a language of great concentration and rhythm. The voice is idiosyncratic and demanding.
assessment.attribution: A single writer in French. A citation could cover a prose of extreme concentration that rethinks biography, fiction and the relation between writing and painting.
assessment.maturity: A small and carefully made oeuvre, admired for quality rather than volume. It is consistent in manner, but narrow in range.
uncertainties: The stylistic effect depends heavily on the French and is very hard to render in translation.
The limited volume of work may weigh against the sustained breadth the will's wording seems to imply.
I know only part of the corpus well.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds that unsettle ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. Her work is radical and unmistakably individual, in some ways comparable with high modernist and Kafkaesque traditions, yet clearly its own. The commitment to a single uncompromising method is itself notable.
assessment.attribution: One author writing in Chinese. A citation could cover an experimental fiction that has moved the boundaries of narrative in modern Chinese literature.
assessment.maturity: A long-running oeuvre with strong consistency. A possible concern is whether the method develops enough, or repeats itself, over many books.
uncertainties: Translation is a significant uncertainty, since the effect depends on tone and syntax, and I cannot read the original.
I am less sure of the full body of work, in particular the later novels, than of the best-known stories.
The abstraction of her writing may divide a committee on the question of its human reach.
